question: Which aquaculture scientist from Karnataka was awarded the Padma Shri 2022 in the Science and Engineering category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subba Nanna Ayyappan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Subba Nanna Ayyappan is a renowned **aquaculture scientist** from Karnataka.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri** in the Science and Engineering category in **2022**.
 
• Ayyappan has made significant contributions to the field of aquaculture and fisheries science in India.
 
• He has held various key positions, including the** Director General of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research** (ICAR).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Shri**

 
 
• The Padma Shri is the** fourth highest civilian award** in the Republic of India, instituted in **1954**.
 
• It is awarded to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the Arts, Education, Industry, Literature, Science, Sports, Medicine, Social Service, and Public Affairs.
 
• The award is announced on the occasion of **Republic Day** every year.
 
 
 
• **Aquaculture**
 
 
• Aquaculture, also known as **aquafarming**, is the controlled process of cultivating aquatic organisms, especially for human consumption.
 
• It involves cultivating freshwater and saltwater populations under controlled conditions, as opposed to commercial fishing, which is the harvesting of wild fish.
 
• Aquaculture encompasses the farming of fish, shellfish, and aquatic plants.
 
• It contributes to food security, income, and employment for millions of people globally.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)**
 
 
• The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) is an autonomous body responsible for coordinating agricultural education and research in India.
 
• It reports to the **Department of Agricultural Research and Education**, Ministry of Agriculture.
